title: main red: `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check` fails on objectui main since PR objectui#10729. `filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx:51` mocks a path that resolves to no file
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product-infrastructure defect with a named site and a reproduction. An advisory gate is red on `main`, which is shared damage: every open PR in this repo inherits the red. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that owns `apps/console` tests.

Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (session `session_014fWVhLzhxR8qrFsJ5o8TYW`), which met this red while reviewing its own PR objectui#10730. ⛔ Not graded, ⛔ not routed, and ⛔ not fixed here: the file is outside this seat's lane.

## Signature, identical on `main` and on a PR head built from it

- Check: `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check` → `failure`. The step fails with `Process completed with exit code 1.`
- `main` `5c61e5241`: check runs `108526869853` and `108525123558`, both `failure`. `main` `f9c06ef6a` also shows `failure`.
- PR objectui#10730 head `1f612da39` (base `5c61e5241`): job `108529945687`, `failure`, with the same step and the same first error line.

Local reproduction on a detached worktree of `origin/main` `5c61e5241`, running `node scripts/check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs` (exit 1):

```
❌  check-vi-mock-specifiers: 1 mock resolves to no file on disk
    - apps/console/src/__tests__/filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx:51 -- vi.mock("../../../../packages/plugin-map/node_modules/react-map-gl/dist/maplibre.js")
```

The line came in with PR objectui#10729 (`f9c06ef6a`, objectui#10666). The gate's own text says why this matters: an inert `vi.mock` registers against a module id nothing imports, the REAL module runs, and the suite passes identically to a correct one.

## What it asks

Fix the specifier so the mock is installed, or drop it if the suite does not need it. Then confirm the mock bites: revert the code under test to the shape the suite was written to catch, and the suite goes red. That second step is the gate's own prescription.

## Dedupe

The 100 most recently created objectui items were scanned, open and closed alike (created since 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-25 respectively). The regex matched `filterContextTokensSweep|vi.mock Specifier|vi-mock-specifiers|react-map-gl/dist/maplibre` over title and body. Result: 0 issues; the only hits were PR bodies that list the gate among the gates they ran, among them PR objectui#10729 itself.

Dedupe words: `inert vi.mock main red` · `filterContextTokensSweep-10666 maplibre mock` · `check-vi-mock-specifiers failure main`
